input_zh: Reading 权威控制固定于 main 提交 0b7b0ae594b55b00ecb97f3d61c2b503d41f8821。该提交包含 Research Runtime Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Reading Prompt v1.0.0（声明 SHA-256 为 9ad93d7f4cd7859fc0b32fa9b3b9e2b836a177c889addcc67d0b4fdc3261d7b5）以及全部 5 个 requiredSources；5/5 requiredSources 均从同一控制提交完整读取，精确 Head 的 Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 34921812449 已通过 worker-prompts:validate，对 Generated Prompt/Checksum 集执行确定性校验。已核验同日 Reading Wake Receipt 为 research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-15/reading-110123.json。Ordered Runtime Reconciliation 于 11:05:24+08:00 打开 Reading，原生 Worker Claim 路径于 11:07:19+08:00 在提交 21a23347c6f911fa7b7f7037f9d252841e75b0cf 中持久记录 Worker Claimed。Reading 只消费同日已完成的 2026-09-15 Research Plan，其中 Q-20260915-01、Q-20260915-02 为 Selected P0 Object，Industry Architecture 明确为 No Selection。
workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects without performing Research Analysis. Q-20260915-01 read LifeFuse-Mem across lifecycle definitions, stable/plastic update routing, controlled anti-overwrite protocol, public long-memory compatibility checks, ablations and limits. The controlled 1,000-episode experiment supports a bounded finding that explicit lifecycle-labelled writes, supervised routing and phase-aware protected readout can reduce temporary overwrite of acquired permanent facts, while the strongest reported configurations still retain substantial overwrite. The paper assumes lifecycle labels and phase/query lifecycle are already known; it does not demonstrate autonomous lifecycle discovery, transient-to-durable promotion, revocation after contradiction, production latency/storage behavior, or authority to classify a memory as durable. Q-20260915-02 read LAST-CQ across its five-stage architecture, 2,471 live-database queries, six backbones, independent and counterfactual baselines, recovery calculations, feedback ablation, equal-budget parallel sampling, judge calibration, failure categories and limitations. The bounded finding is that execution-grounded failure detection plus explicit recovery routing and one bounded retry recover a large share of initial failures in this structured domain (91.7% unweighted mean recovery; 93.8% pooled), while richer grounded feedback adds only about one point in aggregate exact-match and equal-budget Best-of-3 can perform worse. The study does not establish semantic correctness from non-empty execution, general retry safety for state-changing tools, authorization continuity, exactly-once effects, or cross-domain transfer. Reading created exactly two same-date Reading Notes and performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
workResult_zh: 已对两个同日 Selected Object 完成来源完整 Deep Reading，未执行 Research Analysis。Q-20260915-01 完整深读 LifeFuse-Mem 的 Lifecycle 定义、Stable/Plastic 更新路由、受控 Anti-overwrite 协议、公开长记忆兼容性实验、消融与限制。其 1,000 Episode 受控实验支持一个有界结论：显式 Lifecycle-labelled Write、监督式 Routing 与 Phase-aware Protected Readout 可以降低已获得 Permanent Fact 被 Temporary Fact 覆盖的比例，但最强配置仍存在显著 Overwrite。论文假设 Lifecycle Label 与 Phase/Query Lifecycle 已知；并未证明自主 Lifecycle Discovery、Transient-to-durable Promotion、矛盾后的 Revocation、生产 Latency/Storage 行为，或谁有权把一条 Memory 分类为 Durable。Q-20260915-02 完整深读 LAST-CQ 的五阶段架构、2,471 个 Live-database Query、六个 Backbone、独立与 Counterfactual Baseline、Recovery 计算、Feedback Ablation、Equal-budget Parallel Sampling、Judge Calibration、Failure Category 与限制。有界结论是：在该结构化可执行领域，Execution-grounded Failure Detection、显式 Recovery Routing 与一次 Bounded Retry 可以恢复大量初次失败（六模型非加权平均 Recovery 91.7%，Pooled 93.8%）；更复杂的 Grounded Feedback 对总体 Exact-match 仅增加约 1 个百分点，而等预算 Best-of-3 可能更差。该研究不能把 Non-empty Execution 升级为 Semantic Correctness，也未证明状态变更工具的一般 Retry Safety、Authorization Continuity、Exactly-once Effect 或跨领域迁移。Reading 共形成 2 份同日 Reading Note，未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。
